assessment: The paper by Venkova et al. is a comprehensive study of mammalian cell volume dynamics during the common cellular process of adhesion and spreading on a flat substrate, osmotic changes, and mechanical confinement. The paper reveals a complex interplay between cell water/ion regulation, cytoskeletal processes, and mechanical deformation of the cell. The topic is important in cell physiology and should be of considerable interest to cell biologists, mechanobiologists and biophysicists.
